title: Healthy Relationships — Keep the Spark
description: Recurring rituals for couples to nurture affection, shared time, and intimacy. Frequencies are editable starting points, not Gottman prescriptions. Inspired by the Gottman Institute: https://www.gottman.com/blog/5-rituals-reconnect-relationship/

items.title: I love you
items.description: Express affection sincerely with words, a message, or a personal gesture. Choose something that feels natural to you both. Learn more — Gottman Institute: https://www.gottman.com/blog/5-rituals-reconnect-relationship/

items.title: Appreciation
items.description: Thank your partner for one specific thing you appreciated. Name the action and what it meant to you. Learn more — Gottman Institute: https://www.gottman.com/blog/rituals-of-gratitude/

items.title: Check-in
items.description: Spend 10–15 minutes sharing how your day has felt, with phones put away. Take turns listening; ask whether your partner wants support or help with solutions. Learn more — Gottman Institute: https://www.gottman.com/blog/5-rituals-reconnect-relationship/

items.title: Date night
items.description: Protect time just for the two of you: dinner, a walk, or a date at home. Take turns planning something you both enjoy. Learn more — Gottman Institute: https://www.gottman.com/blog/5-rituals-reconnect-relationship/

items.title: Sexy time
items.description: Make room for intimacy you both want. Share preferences and respect each other’s boundaries; affection does not need to lead to sex. Track freely, without a numerical target. Learn more — Gottman Institute: https://info.gottman.com/blog/increase-intimacy-in-your-relationship-with-10-proven-techniques

items.title: Flowers
items.description: Bring flowers, write a note, or offer a small surprise chosen around your partner’s tastes. A thoughtful gesture can be free. Learn more — Gottman Institute: https://www.gottman.com/blog/rituals-of-gratitude/

items.title: Us review
items.description: Share what has felt good in your relationship and one thing you would like to improve together. Agree on one small, practical change. Learn more — Gottman Institute: https://www.gottman.com/blog/5-rituals-reconnect-relationship/

items.title: Something new
items.description: Choose a new activity, place, or experience together. Keep it manageable and focused on enjoying each other’s company. Learn more — Gottman Institute: https://www.gottman.com/blog/5-rituals-reconnect-relationship/
